c.v: Transmitter output can be modulated with a carrier wave by setting RMT_CARRIER_EN_CH
In a carrier cycle, the high level lasts for (RMT_CARRIER_HIGH_CH
+ 1) rmt_sclk cycles, while the low level lasts for (RMT_CARRIER_LOW_CH
is set, carrier wave is added on the high-level of output signals; while RMT_CARRIER_OUT_LV_CH
is cleared, carrier wave is added on the low-level of output signals.
Carrier wave can be added on all output signals during modulation, or just added on valid pulse codes (the data stored in RAM), which can be set by configuring RMT_CARRIER_EFF_EN_CH
0: add carrier wave on all output signals.
1: add carrier wave only on valid signals.
